cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Could my bicycle come inside the cafe just this once?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Wonderful. I'll note rain as an accepted condition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow it's Jo on the counter. She'll put it back outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave Jo a note: 'Bicycle admitted in rain.' I'll show her that before I show her the bicycle.

confusable: D172 preserves an approval; D176 first gets a rule bent and then treats the exception as precedent.
comparison: Weather accommodation across staff shifts differs from creating a first deadline extension.
seedUse: Keep rain condition and Jo's different practice, making professional handover wording the method.
